page: Google Cloud Platform z4d-highmem-16-standardlssd is a storage-optimized virtual machine belonging to the z4d server family. It features 16 dedicated vCPUs built on the x86_64 CPU architecture, paired with 126.0 GB of system memory. This configuration yields a memory-to-core ratio of 7.88 GB per vCPU.

The instance includes a bundled local storage configuration consisting of one NVMe SSD with a total capacity of 3758 GB. There are no graphics processing units integrated into this server type, and it does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

From a resource density perspective, the server offers a high ratio of local NVMe storage and memory relative to its compute cores. This makes it structurally efficient for workloads requiring low-latency local storage access and significant memory capacity without the overhead of higher vCPU counts. Appropriate workloads include database hosting, transactional databases, and storage-heavy applications that benefit from direct-attached NVMe SSDs.
